interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Sau:[/b][/color] Duy is my son. He was unloading with me that night. He could not have hurt Binh.

response_choices: He told me what he heard.

interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Sau:[/b][/color] He heard an argument, then something being dragged. He has been afraid Hanh would come for him too.
[color=#ffffff][b]Sau:[/b][/color] I am taking him to Phuc now. Thank you for letting him finish.
